common.name: Name
sidebar.tipTitle: A little order. A big difference.
sidebar.tipBody: Know where your files live. Focus on what matters.
hero.eyebrow: A FRESH START FOR YOUR DESKTOP
hero.title: Everything in its place
hero.body: Organize your desktop into smart groups. Make room to think.
groups.title: Your smart groups
groups.caption: A place for everything.
panel.title: Your desktop, under control
panel.body: Review before organizing. Put everything just where you want it.
panel.keepLocal: Your files stay on your device. You stay in control.
panel.demoNote: Showing demo data. Launch the desktop app for real operations.
empty.title: A little room to breathe.
empty.body: Scan again for new files or discover installed apps.
empty.filteredBody: Try a different search or category.
empty.systemBody: Search Program Files, Start Menu and registered app paths with a deep scan.
scan.title: System Scanner
scan.body: Discover installed apps. Keep them in place and organize desktop shortcuts.
scan.safe: Installed programs are never moved. Confirmation creates shortcuts in category folders.
scan.limited: Scan limit reached. Results may be partial.
scan.cancelled: Scan stopped. Discovered results are preserved.
scan.warnings: {count} source/access warnings. Unavailable locations were skipped.
scan.unsupported: Deep scanning is unavailable on this platform. Desktop scanning is still available.
settings.title: Your desktop. Your rules.
settings.body: Preferences stay on this device. Pick up where you left off.
settings.iconsNote: Icon packs customize the interface and new shortcuts. On Windows, new category folders receive Explorer icons; existing file icons are unchanged.
settings.moveBody: Desktop files are moved into category folders.
settings.copyBody: Originals stay on the desktop. Copies go into category folders.
settings.approval: Every operation needs your approval. Existing files are never overwritten.
settings.autoScanBody: Only scans. Never moves files without approval.
settings.hidden: Hidden files, folders and symbolic links are excluded from desktop scans.
history.title: Operation history
history.empty: No operations yet. Your first one will appear here.
history.note: Undo starts with the latest active operation. Modified files are protected.
preview.title: One last look.
preview.body: {count} items ready. Confirm to create the destinations below.
preview.demo: You are in demo mode. Real files will not change.
preview.skipNote: Conflicting items will be skipped. Existing files are never overwritten.
preview.verified: Content is verified. Undo is available from operation history.
manager.title: Make room for every idea.
manager.body: Build your own groups, subfolders and matching rules.
manager.deleteNote: Removes the category, its subgroups and linked rules from this list. Files and folders on disk are not deleted.
manager.lastCategory: At least one category must remain.
manager.folderNote: Folder names stay fixed across languages. Used for new operations; existing folders are not renamed.
manager.ruleBody: First matching rule wins. Manual assignments always take priority.
manager.ruleEmpty: No personal rules yet. Add your first one.
notify.scanned: Scan complete. Review the suggested categories.
notify.demoReveal: Use the desktop app to reveal files in their folders.
footer.tagline: A CLEANER DESKTOP. A CLEARER MIND.
errors.SETTINGS_READ: Saved settings could not be read. Check the settings file.
errors.CATEGORIES_INVALID: At least one valid category is required.
errors.CATEGORY_DUPLICATE: Category ID or folder path already exists.
errors.CATEGORY_CYCLE: Subgroups cannot form a cycle; up to 16 levels are supported.
errors.RULE_INVALID: Check the rule and destination category.
errors.TARGET_DUPLICATE: Multiple apps resolve to the same destination.
errors.SCAN_BUSY: A system scan is already running.
errors.SHORTCUT_UNSUPPORTED: Shortcut creation for this app type is unavailable on this platform.
errors.TARGET_EXISTS: A file with this name already exists at the destination.
errors.OPERATION_FAILED: The operation could not be completed. Check the details.
errors.OPERATION_BUSY: A file operation is in progress. Please wait.
errors.HISTORY_READ: Operation history could not be read. No files were changed.
errors.DESKTOP_READ: Cannot read the desktop. Check its OneDrive path and permissions.
errors.TARGET_UNSAFE: Destination folder is a symbolic link or an invalid file.
errors.DUPLICATE_ITEM: The same file was selected more than once.
errors.SOURCE_MISSING: The source is missing or unsafe. Scan again.
errors.PREVIEW_EXPIRED: Preview expired. Open a new preview.
errors.NO_READY: No items without conflicts are available.
errors.SOURCE_CHANGED: A source changed after preview. Scan again.
errors.COPY_VERIFY: The copy could not be verified. The source was preserved.
errors.OPERATION_INTERRUPTED: Operation stopped. Completed steps can be undone from history.
errors.HISTORY_UNSAFE: History contains an unsafe path. Files are preserved.
errors.NO_UNDO: There is no operation to undo.
errors.UNCERTAIN_TARGET: Destination ownership is uncertain after interruption. Check both files manually.
errors.RESTORE_CHANGED: Restored source changed or is missing. Destination is preserved.
errors.TARGET_MISSING: Destination is missing or changed. Undo stopped.
errors.TARGET_CHANGED: Destination content changed. Undo stopped to protect new data.
errors.SOURCE_CHANGED_RETAINED: Source changed. Recovery copy is preserved.
errors.SOURCE_EXISTS: Another file exists at the original location. It was not overwritten.
errors.RESTORE_VERIFY: Restored source could not be verified. Destination is preserved.
errors.IPC_DENIED: This window is not allowed to perform this operation.
errors.WATCH_FAILED: Live monitoring stopped. You can scan manually.
profiles.title: Choose your focus. Let everything else fade.
profiles.body: A profile hides unrelated desktop items. Files are never moved or deleted.
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.safety: Previously hidden items stay hidden. On quit or recovery, DarkDesk restores its own changes.
profiles.unsupported: Desktop visibility is unavailable on this platform.
profiles.linux: Linux uses a .hidden list; visual support depends on your desktop manager.
profiles.demo: Demo: visibility is simulated. Browser shortcuts only work while this page is focused.
launcher.title: Quick Launcher
launcher.empty: No matches. Try another name or command.
launcher.demo: Demo: real applications are not launched.
automation.title: Let order work in the background.
automation.body: Rules run locally only after you enable them. Every move can be undone from history.
automation.archiveBody: Moves desktop files older than X days based on last modification time.
automation.downloadsBody: Routes new, stable downloads into desktop category folders using file types and rules.
automation.warning: Enabled rules process files in the background without a confirmation dialog. Operations are logged and never overwrite conflicts.
automation.disabled: Automation is off. Enable and save a rule first.
automation.demo: The web demo only uses sample data. Real monitoring runs in Electron.
filters.title: Scan filters
filters.body: Start Menu is an explicit scan root; other AppData directories are excluded. DLL/SYS/INI files are not indexed.
filters.help: Separate with commas or newlines. Allowed names override helper-app filters.
smart.title: Local smart tagging
smart.body: Compares unknown filenames with category keyword vectors. Works offline and does not read file contents.
smart.note: Similarity is not a calibrated accuracy percentage. You decide.
usage.title: Usage & archive suggestions
usage.body: Only launches observed through DarkDesk are recorded. Launches elsewhere in Windows or other apps are not measured.
usage.inactive: Not launched through DarkDesk for 6+ months
manager.regexHelp: Uses the safe RE2 subset. Lookaround and backreferences are unsupported. Example: setup|installer|driver|update
drag.hint: Drag onto a category or use the dropdown
drag.assigned: Category updated. Confirm organization to change physical files.
tray.note: X hides the window to the tray. Use the tray menu to quit.
errors.RULE_REGEX_INVALID: Regex is invalid or unsupported by RE2.
errors.SHORTCUT_INVALID: Enter a shortcut such as Ctrl+Alt+1.
errors.SHORTCUT_DUPLICATE: The same shortcut is assigned more than once.
errors.VISIBILITY_UNSUPPORTED: Visibility changes are unsupported on this platform.
errors.VISIBILITY_FAILED: File visibility could not be changed. Check permissions and retry restore.
errors.RUNTIME_STATE_READ: Could not read local runtime state.
errors.DROP_INVALID: Only regular files in Desktop and Downloads can be dropped.
automation.undoNote: Files restored with Undo are not processed again until they change.
info.title: Application and file information
info.usageNote: Only successful launch requests made through DarkDesk are recorded. Usage from other apps is not monitored.
info.loadError: Could not read file information. The file may have moved or become inaccessible.
info.demoNote: Browser preview: native icons and company information are read only in the desktop app.
shortcuts.help: Click to record a shortcut. Use Ctrl, Alt or Command with a key. Save to apply.
shortcuts.recordingHelp: Global shortcuts are paused while recording. Escape cancels; Tab leaves this field.
shortcuts.duplicate: This combination is already assigned in DarkDesk. Choose another combination.
shortcuts.globalHelp: These shortcuts work while DarkDesk is in the tray. Another application or the OS can reserve a combination; choose a different one if unavailable. Your previous working assignment is kept when a replacement fails.
shortcuts.demoHelp: Browser preview: shortcuts work only while this page is focused. Global registration is available in the desktop app.
errors.SHORTCUT_UNAVAILABLE: This shortcut is reserved by the OS or another app. Your previous assignment was kept. Choose another combination.
help.title: A tidier desktop in a few steps.
help.body: Review first, then apply. This guide helps you understand what will change when organizing your files.
help.scan.title: Find your items
help.scan.body: Scan your desktop files. The installed apps view can also find programs on your computer; their installation folders stay in place.
help.review.title: Review your groups
help.review.body: Choose a destination group on each card or drag a card onto a category. These choices do not move files immediately. Use Organize to preview the destinations.
help.confirm.title: Move or copy
help.confirm.body: Choose move or copy in Settings. Review which file goes where, then confirm. Installed programs receive desktop shortcuts.
help.undo.title: Undo if needed
help.undo.body: Use Undo in the notification after an operation. You can also undo the latest organization later from Operation History in Settings.
help.shortcutsNative: Your current assignments are shown below. If another application reserves a global key, choose a different combination in Profiles.
help.shortcutsDemo: In the browser preview, shortcuts work only while this page is focused. Your current assignments are shown below.
help.closeDialog: Close an information or preview panel
help.trayBody: When a system tray is available, X hides DarkDesk to the tray; shortcuts and enabled automations keep working. Choose Quit from the tray menu to exit fully. Items hidden by your profile are restored on exit.
help.demoBody: This browser preview does not change your files or provide native window/tray controls. Real file operations are available in the desktop app.
help.personalizeBody: Choose a light or dark theme, larger text, card density and reduced motion in Settings. Your preferences are kept for the next launch.
help.localBody: Scanning, grouping and tag suggestions run on your device. These operations do not upload your files to a server.
help.launchHistory: Last launch records only launch requests made through DarkDesk; usage in other applications is not monitored.
errors.SHORTCUT_CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE: Bring the DarkDesk window to the front to record a shortcut.
appearance.intro: Adjust the workspace to your room and reading preferences. Changes save automatically.
appearance.motionNote: The operating system’s reduced motion preference is always respected.
appearance.theme.midnight: Deep navy with soft purple accents.
appearance.theme.rose: Warm light surfaces and rose accents.
appearance.theme.contrast: Clear edges with black and yellow.
desktop.reviewHint: Review destination folders, then confirm to apply.
desktop.systemHint: Installed programs stay in place; shortcuts are added to category folders.
purpose.title: What does it do?
purpose.catalogNote: This description comes from the DarkDesk knowledge catalog matched to the application name or local target.
purpose.inferenceNote: This is a general estimate based on file type or category. File content and behavior have not been analyzed.
purpose.originalIcon: Native icon read from the file
purpose.fallbackIcon: Native icon unavailable: name initials and category symbol are shown.
receipt.title: Organization result
receipt.summary: {moved} moved · {copied} copied · {shortcuts} shortcuts created · {skipped} skipped · {failed} failed
receipt.cosmetic: {count} appearance/date settings could not be applied. File operation results are shown above.
errors.FOLDER_ICON_FAILED: The custom folder icon could not be applied.
errors.TIMESTAMP_NOT_PRESERVED: The original file timestamp could not be preserved.
errors.SHORTCUT_ICON_FALLBACK: The custom icon was unavailable; the application icon was used.
errors.SOURCE_REMOVE_FAILED: A verified copy was created, but the source could not be removed. Both source and destination were kept.
errors.OPEN_FOLDER_FAILED: The destination folder could not be opened.
scan.desktopHint: Only desktop files and shortcuts are scanned. Organization is applied after preview and confirmation.
scan.downloadsHint: Only files in Downloads are scanned. Files are organized into the chosen category after confirmation.
appearance.theme.graphite: Neutral graphite with soft blue accents.
appearance.theme.amber: Warm amber over dark brown surfaces.
appearance.theme.lavender: Light lavender surfaces and violet accents.
appearance.fontNote: Uses fonts installed on this device, with local fallbacks where unavailable. No font downloads are required.
empty.downloads: No items to show in Downloads.
empty.downloadsBody: Scan your Downloads folder again or select another source.
update.title: Application updates
update.body: Check for new releases, download them and install through DarkDesk.
update.unsupported.development: Update the development version from its source code. Use the Windows Setup EXE version for in-app installation.
update.unsupported.portable: Update the portable version manually from the download page. In-app installation is available in the Windows Setup EXE version.
update.unsupported.platform: In-app installation is unavailable on this platform. Get the appropriate version from the download page.
update.unsupported.unavailable: In-app updates are unavailable in this version. You can open the official download page.
update.ready: The update has downloaded. Restart and install when you are ready.
update.waitForFiles: Wait for the current file operation to finish before installing the update.
update.policy: New releases are checked regularly. Downloads and restarts require your confirmation.
update.noticeBody: Review the new release and download it from the app.
update.noticeReadyBody: Restart and update when you are ready.
update.errors.UPDATE_NETWORK: Could not connect to the update server. Check your internet connection and try again.
update.errors.UPDATE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The update files cannot be accessed. Check the official download page and try again later.
update.errors.UPDATE_METADATA: The update information could not be read. Check again later.
update.errors.UPDATE_INTEGRITY: The downloaded file could not be verified. Nothing was installed; try downloading it again.
update.errors.UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The update could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
update.errors.UPDATE_ACCESS: Access to the update file was denied. You can install manually from the download page.
update.errors.UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: The update check could not finish. Try again later.
update.errors.UPDATE_INSTALL_FAILED: The update could not be installed. Try again or get the installer from the download page.
update.errors.UPDATE_BUSY: Another update operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
update.errors.UPDATE_NOT_READY: Download the update before installing it.
update.errors.GENERIC: The update could not finish. Try again or open the official download page.
update.errors.UPDATE_CANCELLED: The update download was cancelled. Try again when you are ready.
update.access.title: Private repository access
update.access.configured: Update access is configured on this device.
update.access.required: The DarkDesk repository is private. Add an access token to check for updates.
update.access.label: GitHub access token
update.access.storage: The token is encrypted using secure operating-system storage. Saved tokens are never loaded back into this field.
update.access.unsupported: Secure token storage is unavailable in this version. Use the Windows installer version or download the EXE in a browser signed in to GitHub.
update.access.guide: Create a fine-grained personal access token in GitHub settings for the DarkDesk repository only. Under Repository permissions, Contents: Read-only is sufficient. Manage expiry and repository access rules on GitHub.
update.access.secret: Do not share the token in chat, issues, screenshots or source code. It is used here only to access update files.
update.access.manual: The manual download page opens the private GitHub Releases page. Sign in with an authorized GitHub account in your browser.
update.errors.UPDATE_AUTH_REQUIRED: Add a GitHub access token to access updates from the private repository.
update.errors.UPDATE_AUTH_FAILED: GitHub access could not be verified. Check token expiry, the DarkDesk repository selection and Contents read permission.
update.errors.UPDATE_ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE: Secure access-token storage is unavailable. The token was not saved; you can use the manual download option.
scanSummary.title: Desktop scan coverage
scanSummary.access: A desktop source could not be read. Items from the available sources are still listed; check the source path and Windows access permissions below.
scanSummary.copyMode: Copy mode is enabled: the original files stay on the desktop. Choose Move in Settings if you want to remove them from their original location.
scanSummary.folders: {count} folders were left in place. Folder contents are not included in the desktop file scan.
scanSummary.excluded: Excluded: {hidden} hidden files and {extensions} files matching extension filters.
scanSummary.warnings: {count} items or sources could not be read. Other items were scanned.
scanSummary.sharedHint: This item is on the shared Windows desktop and is visible to all users.
preview.copyNotice: Copy mode keeps the original files on the desktop. Only the new category copies are created.
preview.sharedMoveNotice: Shared desktop items appear for all Windows users. Moving them removes them from other users’ desktops too. Windows permissions may prevent a move; DarkDesk does not elevate itself automatically.
preview.sharedCopyNotice: These items are on the shared Windows desktop. Copying leaves the originals visible to all users and creates copies in your category folders.
errors.SHARED_DESKTOP_ACCESS: The shared desktop item could not be processed safely. Check its source path and Windows access permissions.
errors.SHARED_DESKTOP_MANUAL_ONLY: Shared desktop items are not moved by automation. Review and confirm them in the organization preview.
errors.DESKTOP_ITEM_ACCESS: A desktop item could not be read. Scanning continued with the other items.
